files.policies.yml:
version: 1
base_currency: OMR
accounts: [salary, savings, broker, cash]
categories:
  income: [salary, bonus, side]
  expense: [housing, food, transport, family, discretionary, fees]
  transfer: [transfer]
  invest: [buy, sell, dividend]
snapshot_max_age_days: 45
policies:
  - id: K1
    type: kill
    title: broker drawdown
    measure: {drawdown: account.broker, window_days: 90}
    limit: {pct: 5}
  - id: CAP-HOLD
    type: cap
    title: food per month
    measure: {sum: expense.food, period: month}
    limit: {value: 100}

files.decisions.yml:
- id: D-due
  date: 2026-06-01
  title: review the food cap
  policy: CAP-HOLD
  criteria: keep if food stays under 100
  review_by: 2026-09-15
  status: open
- id: D-open
  date: 2026-07-01
  title: keep the broker pilot
  policy: K1
  criteria: stop if drawdown > 5% in any 90 days
  review_by: 2027-01-01
  status: open
- id: D-today
  date: 2026-08-01
  title: review on the as-of day itself
  review_by: 2026-09-30
  status: open
- id: D-close
  date: 2026-09-05
  title: end the broker pilot after the August drawdown
  policy: K1
  criteria: drawdown over 5% in 90 days
  review_by: 2026-12-01
  status: closed
  closes: K1
- id: D-bad-closes
  date: 2026-09-06
  title: a cap cannot be closed
  review_by: 2026-12-01
  status: closed
  closes: CAP-HOLD
- id: D-done
  date: 2026-05-01
  title: an old closed decision without a policy
  review_by: 2026-06-01
  status: closed
